description:
Her full name is Takina Inoue.
She excelled as a Lycoris, but ended up working at Café LycoReco due to certain circumstances. She's realistic and hates inefficiency, so she harbors some dissatisfaction toward Chisato, who doesn't behave like a Lycoris.
She wants to achieve meaningful results through her work at LycoReco.

lines.text: Is there anything you need?
Let me know if there's anything I can help with.
Our profits are up from yesterday.
This place shares a lot of similarities with our world. Maybe that's why I feel so comfortable here.
Board games after work...? All right, I can join you for a game.
I'm glad my ideas for new menu items are popular here as well.
If you don't have anything for me, can I go back to the cafe?
Hmm... Taking little breaks like this isn't so bad after all.
Have you seen Chisato? She got excited and ran off just now...
So the battlefield is right above us...? I almost can't believe it, given how peaceful it is here.
We've added a new item to our menu at the cafe. Why not give it a try?
Hello. My name's Takina Inoue.
I never knew you could get stronger like this. I've learned something new.
I feel much stronger now. Thank you.
I'm going to work even harder today.
But you've already done so much for me... Thank you.
Hmm, do you think I'll be able to take this back to my world?
I'll make good use of this. Thank you.
I think I'm going to be sad when I have to go back.
I'm feeling much more of a bond with you than I may have realized.
You've done a lot for me since I arrived here. I appreciate your kindness.
I'll get ready.
Yes.
Moving out.
Enemy spotted.
Ready for combat.
Cover secured.
Here we go.
I'm reloading.
I need to reload.
Give me a moment to regroup.
I'm ready!
I'll clear the way!
Initiating focused fire!
Clear.
Target eliminated.
Engaging next target.
Erk!
Argh!
Ngh...
Retreating for now.
Mission complete. Where's our next target?
